en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a round stone tower with a conical dark-green roof, attached to a larger castle-like building with red tiled roofs. In the foreground there is a cobblestone courtyard bordered by lush greenery and trees, with a lamppost and garden beds along a low wall. An arched passageway leads through the building on the right. The caption text at the top reads "Wurzen" on the left and "Partie am Schloß" on the right.
